en: The postcard consists of two sides: one features an aerial black-and-white photograph of a Scandinavian waterfront city, with prominent buildings, a harbor, and text that reads 'Sundsvall från flygplan' in Swedish. The reverse side includes handwritten text, two postage stamps (one commemorating 1928-1929), and the address field, all written in Swedish. The postmark and stamps denote Swedish origin.
